verdict.rationale: Jitsu ships its own official client-side SDK: a JavaScript integration with a documented JS reference, based on Analytics.js and Segment-compatible, plus a React integration. Beyond the frontend, the evidence shows only a raw HTTP API for backend sending and a Management HTTP API, with no official SDKs. missing for 10: official backend/server-language SDKs, an SDK wrapping the Management API, explicit SDK coverage beyond JavaScript/React, independent hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Jitsu javascript integration is 100% compatible with Segment API. In addition to that we have React integration
The API is based on [Analytics.js](https://getanalytics.io/api/), and is compatible with it.
On frontend, Jitsu uses open-source analytics.js library, which is Segment-compatible.
